selection_rule: First completed match in the date-descending HLTV results window 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-06 with demo available and match ID absent from frozen historical corpus. One complete BO series for the initial pipeline pilot. Selected before download and parsing.

matches.date_basis: HLTV match page as displayed in browser; no timezone inference

isolation: Store under data/evaluation/unseen_v1; never add to historical graph or Milvus. Entire series remains isolated.
evaluation_plan: Parse both maps using frozen implementation; retain failures rather than altering parser then relabeling the run.
Validate source match and maps, round totals and wins against public map scores; record complete roster coverage and event totals.
Run deterministic AnalysisPipeline with remote LLM disabled and only the historical graph as prior evidence; validate current citations and Verifier.
Do not claim retrieval generalization or coaching effectiveness from this single-series engineering pilot.
new_corpus_retrieval_status: Independent queries and qrels not prepared; no retrieval quality evaluation authorized by this manifest alone.
